title: Why am I Still Seeing This: Measuring the Effectiveness Of Ad Controls and Explanations in AI-Mediated Ad Targeting Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on an empirical sociotechnical audit of Facebook's (Meta's) ad controls and targeting explanations. While it discusses societal harms, discrimination, and privacy as motivations, its primary objective is to measure the technical effectiveness and transparency of these features rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
